basic_profile.bio: I'm a dedicated food delivery driver based in Toronto, juggling my passion for music with my day job as a courier. In my free time, I create digital art and play the keyboard in a local band. I'm not a fan of cold weather, which makes winter deliveries a bit of a drag. I usually browse Reddit during my downtime between deliveries, mostly in the evenings. I'm single, enjoying the freedom that comes with it, and I'm always open to new experiences and learning opportunities.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in digital art and music, having pursued them both through self-teaching and community college courses. My knowledge in logistics comes from my hands-on experience as a courier for over 5 years. I keep up with tech trends and tools to enhance my digital art skills.
